requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Lexical ambiguity regarding 'switches ability' resolved by domain context. The phrase is interpreted as the device possessing a capability (noun phrase) rather than performing an action of changing ability. Structured as a single functional requirement describing the system's inherent capability.

source_fragments: Routing switches ability to filter network traffic between data-plane interfaces and management data traffic.

fields.condition: when operating in an industrial railway communication network

structured_requirements.final_statement: The routing switch shall filter network traffic between data-plane interfaces and management data traffic.
structuring_notes: Resolved lexical ambiguity: 'switches ability' interpreted as the device's inherent capability to filter, not an action of changing that capability.
Mapped 'management data traffic' to SNMP traffic on UDP port 161 per glossary.
Mapped 'filter network traffic' to inspecting and dropping packets based on protocol and destination port per glossary.
